description: Anca Dragan is a professor at Berkeley, working on human-robot interaction — algorithms that look beyond the robot’s function in isolation, and generate robot behavior that accounts for interaction and coordination with human beings. classificationReason: Dedicated interview on human-robot interaction, robot behavior, human-aware planning, autonomous driving, and reward specification.
qualityReason: Detailed treatment of human-robot interaction, Bayesian belief updating, information-gathering actions, autonomous driving edge cases, reward design, inductive bias, and unintended consequences, with clear practitioner and research expertise.
